name: isokron-plugins
description: IsoKron's local-first MCP servers for coding agents: kronicle-lite (hash-chained notes with staleness detection), sea-lite (a fenced work queue for parallel agents) and isokron-setup (one-command installer for the whole toolset).

plugins.name: kronicle-lite
plugins.description: Hash-chained local document store with signed retrieval receipts and an orient protocol that tells the agent when its notes went stale.

plugins.name: sea-lite
plugins.description: Fenced work queue for parallel coding agents: leased claims, typed links, atomic batches, hash-chained history. Composes with kronicle-lite.

plugins.name: isokron-setup
plugins.description: One-command installer for the IsoKron toolset: detects Claude Code, Cowork, Cursor, Codex and Copilot, shows one plan, asks once, installs, seeds the wake contract and the chain, runs the first orient, verifies. Reversible.
